title: Closure under shifted OR verification
statement: The verifier model $E$ is closed under shifted OR verification if, for every Boolean verifier $M$ and all natural numbers $a,k,a',k'$, whenever $M$ is efficient according to $E$, the shifted OR verifier built from $M$ using the polynomial length functions determined by $(a,k)$ and $(a',k')$ is an efficient two-witness verifier according to $E$.
hypotheses_covered: For every M and natural numbers a,k,a′,k′
If M is efficient according to E
The shifted OR verifier using polyLen(a,k) and polyLen(a′,k′) is an efficient two-witness verifier according to E
